title: Flagship Cruises & Events
specs: Indoor climate-controlled seating and open-air decks
Scenic views of San Diego landmarks including Coronado Bridge and Naval Base
Children under 12 must be accompanied by an adult; kids under 4 cruise free except on Patriot Jet Boat
Guests on Patriot Jet Boat must be able to transfer in and out of vessel
No official dress code; dinner cruise guests tend to dress more formally
Private events available; ship exclusive for private bookings
Groups 20 or larger should contact event team for special rates
Corporate events for groups 20-600, private cruise 3-4 hours

blurb: Guests board at 990 N Harbor Drive, San Diego, CA. Cruises include sightseeing tours, whale watching, dining cruises, and ferry services. The fleet is Coast Guard certified and offers indoor climate-controlled seating and open-air decks.
